Phil Schaap was born in New York City on April 8, 1951. He grew up surrounded by jazz and its prominent players and began his career as a jazz DJ at WKCR in 1970. Phil has produced numerous recordings and is an important source of historical accuracy in jazz reissues. He has taught at Princeton and The New School and played an important role in Ken Burns’ documentary “Jazz.”
Phil was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 9, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
